episodes.title: Some Catholic Podcast- Approached By A Cult | Episode 42
episodes.description:
Welcome back. Please don't forget to hit subscribe and to follow us across all platforms of social media. Today on Some Catholic Podcast, we warn you about a cult that tried to recruit us. Yes, some cult members of the Unification Church have tried recruiting us over a year ago, and this is the story of what we learned. For the different links about the cult, please see below. There are a few documentaries about them and even lots of short form videos on youtube or tik tok that tell you about how awful it is. 
Please pray for us and please share this with a friend. I cannot explain how grateful we are to those who listen and watch our content. God bless. Also, we are not theologians in the sense of having any degree. If there are issues with what we say, please correct us. If we do not answer your question the way you wish, please always refer to the Catechism and/ or your local priest. Our opinions are our own. 
Link tree is below : ⁠⁠⁠https://linktr.ee/somecatholicpodcast⁠
